<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1784056_sixscape.get_token</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>get_token</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var get_token = Class.create();
get_token.prototype = {
    TestConnection: function() {
        try {
            var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
            var payload = {
                "uid": gs.getProperty("x_1784056_sixscape.Application ID"),
                "credential": gs.getProperty("x_1784056_sixscape.Application Secret")
            };
            var mid_server = gs.getProperty("x_1784056_sixscape.Mid Server Name");
            if (mid_server != "") {
                r.setMIDServer(mid_server);
                r.setEccParameter('skip_sensor', 'true');
            }
            var endpoint = gs.getProperty("x_1784056_sixscape.End Point") || "";
            // Remove trailing slash if present
            if (endpoint.endsWith("/")) {
                endpoint = endpoint.substring(0, endpoint.length - 1);
            }
            endpoint = endpoint + "/v1/auth";
            r.setHttpMethod("post");
            r.setRequestHeader('User-Agent', 'snow');
            r.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/json");
            r.setEndpoint(endpoint);
            r.setRequestBody(JSON.stringify(payload));
            r.setHttpTimeout(60000);
            var response = r.executeAsync();
            var status = response.getStatusCode();
            var responseBody = response.getBody();
			return [status, responseBody];
        } catch (error) {
            return [500, "Error during token retrieval: " + error.message];
        }

    },
    type: 'get_token'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-09 13:52:59</sys_created_on><sys_id>7414ac87c32aa21087613342b4013106</sys_id><sys_mod_count>7</sys_mod_count><sys_name>get_token</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Sixscape IDcentral" source="x_1784056_sixscape">42bb04c3c3a6a21087613342b40131c0</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Sixscape IDcentral">42bb04c3c3a6a21087613342b40131c0</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_7414ac87c32aa21087613342b4013106</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-09 14:50:38</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
